{{Quote|Welcome aboard! I'm Bastila Shan. We've been expecting you. Do you have the codes?|Jedi Knight Bastila Shan, welcoming a group of Republic agents aboard the ''Viscount''|<ref name="TBODR" />}}
The '''''Viscount''''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]]. In [[3957 BBY]], the ''Viscount'' accompanied a small Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to the Republic's border with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire, to rendezvous with a group of Republic [[Agent/Legends|agents]]. The agents arrived at the meeting point and landed aboard the ''Viscount'', then attended a briefing about an [[Capture of Darth Revan|upcoming strike]] against the Sith.

==History==
The ''Viscount'' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] that served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict waged between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]].<ref name="TBODR" /> In [[3957 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' gives a date of [[3956 BBY]] as the year that Revan searches for the Star Forge as a retrained Jedi. When Revan visited the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine, [[Deesra Luur Jada]] tells him that Bastila Shan and her strike team had assaulted Darth Revan's ship nearly a year ago (Dialog StrRef 6568). Therefore, a date of 3957 BBY is used as the date of Darth Revan's capture.</ref> the ''Viscount'' was assigned to be the [[Flagship/Legends|lead ship]]<ref name="TBODR" /> of a small<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], which had assembled near the Republic's border with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire. The fleet waited there to rendezvous with a group of [[Agent/Legends|agents]] who had been [[Mission to Sernpidal|sent]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]], in order to obtain command codes that would allow the Republic to bypass the [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] of the [[Sith armada (Jedi Civil War)|Sith fleet]].<ref name="TBODR" />

When the agents' [[Starship/Legends|starship]] arrived at the rendezvous point, it hailed the ''Viscount'' with an authorization code, and four [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|''Aurek''-class tactical strikefighters]] then escorted the agents into the ''Viscount''{{'s}} [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay. Once the agents had disembarked, they were greeted by a group of [[Republic soldier]]s and led to a conference room, where several high-ranking Republic [[Officer/Legends|officers]] had congregated, to plan their next strike against the Sith. The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]] welcomed the agents, then briefed the officers on a plan to engage the Sith fleet and capture [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]], the leader of the Sith Empire. Afterward, the Republic fleet departed from the meeting point to face the Sith fleet, and during the resulting [[Capture of Darth Revan|battle]], the Republic agents launched from the ''Viscount'' in Aurek strikefighters. The operation went to plan, and Shan was able to apprehend Revan.<ref name="TBODR" />

==Commanders and crew==
Various [[Species/Legends|species]] were represented among the ''Viscount''{{'s}} officers, including [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], and a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]]. A number of Republic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] also served aboard the ship.<ref name="TBODR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Viscount'' was created by [[Patrick Stutzman]] and featured in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] scenario ''[[The Betrayal of Darth Revan]]'',<ref name="TBODR" /> which was released at the [[Wikipedia:Gen Con|Gen Con]] gaming convention in [[August]] [[2008]].<ref name="Gen Con">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=rpga/genconindy/info08|text=Gen Con: The best four days in gaming!}}</ref> The scenario was later made available as a free download on the Internet.<ref name="Yahoo">{{WebCite|url=http://games.groups.yahoo.com/group/D20StarwarsRPG/message/1937|text=Free KotOR adventure! "The Betrayal Of Darth Revan"|author=Rob P.|date=2009-04-21|work=[https://web.archive.org/web/20101208175255/http://games.dir.groups.yahoo.com/dir/Games Yahoo Groups]|archivedate=20101205110325|nolive=1}}</ref>
